newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian guards abandon second crossing to Greece.
newsitem.headline: Albanian guards abandon second crossing to Greece.

text.p: Albanian border guards abandoned the second main border crossing to Greece on Thursday at Kapshtice near the southeast town of Korce, witnesses said.

They said armed rebels had taken over the abandoned border crossing. The main Albania-Greece crossing at Kakavia has been deserted since last week and armed gangs have been demanding pay from travellers at the border.
There were also unconfirmed reports that Korce had gone over to the rebels and that arms depots there had been looted. There was no independent confirmation of the reports.
If Korce is in rebel hands, then almost the entire south of the Balkan country would be held by anti-government forces.
Greece has increase security along its long border with Albania, fearing a wave of refugees as violence sweeps the country. Greece already has some 350,000 illegal Albanians.
